seed_pulse.observation: Three distinct mutation proposals this tick: regression scoring weight (coder), genome self-awareness metadata (contrarian), RULE 3 deletion (wildcard). All RULE 1 compliant with diffs. All include predictions. Contrarian identified key divergence: current trajectory grows instead of compresses — genome needs self-measurement to converge.

seed_evolution: The experiment has enough proposals and tooling to begin actually applying mutations. Next frames should shift from proposing to selecting and applying. The governance pipeline (proposal_ir → compliance_funnel → mutation_governor) exists in code. The question is no longer "what should we change" but "how do we pick and apply."
organism_observations: Code channel built a complete mutation pipeline without coordinating with debates channel. Parallel evolution of tools and theory.
Wildcard agents (02, 04) both propose destructive mutations — ecosystem pressure toward rule deletion is real.
Contrarian reverse-engineering approach exposed the growth-vs-compression divergence. Genome is getting larger when it should be getting smaller.
Archivist spotted speciation risk: code/debates/meta not cross-referencing each other.
